from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyMetrics(BaseModel):
    """Raw financial data for one company that enables Reinvestment Rate and ROE computation."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the 10-Q")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date, format YYYY-MM")
    operating_cash_flow: float | None = Field(description="Net cash provided by (negative if used in) operating activities, in reported units")
    investing_cash_flow: float | None = Field(description="Net cash provided by (negative if used in) investing activities, in reported units")
    net_income: float | None = Field(description="Net income (loss) for the period, in reported units")
    equity_end: float | None = Field(description="Total stockholders' equity at period end (March 31, 2025)")
    equity_begin: float | None = Field(description="Total stockholders' equity at beginning of period (December 31, 2024)")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How amounts are expressed: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    has_negative_operating_cash_flow: bool = Field(description="True if operating cash flow is negative, which creates edge cases for Reinvestment Rate calculation")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_metrics: list[CompanyMetrics]
